title: Anthropic’s Mythos 5 is back
brief: Anthropic's Mythos 5 model has been cleared to resume operations for select organizations following a two-week negotiation with the Trump administration, per a June 26 letter from Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick. However, the public-facing Fable 5 variant remains blocked with no clear timeline for resolution, indicating a partial restoration of service after what appears to be a regulatory pause.
